provenance.notes: All payload envelopes, platform capabilities, gate states and metric intervals are invented for contract testing; they are not specifications, clinical limits or deployment permission.

mission_scenarios.operating_notes: Synthetic authorized-waterway delivery, including loading and cold-chain handover.
Synthetic short waterway passage with seated and wheelchair passengers; board/transfer and egress included.
Synthetic survey on an approved path with fragile instruments and contained samples.
Synthetic movement of a two-person field crew between authorized sites.
Synthetic station resupply; cold-soak route with an instrument requiring a controlled compartment.
Synthetic patient transfer envelope only; no clinical protocol or field clearance is implied.
Synthetic hot-soak/dust mission on a surveyed route with tools and fragile inspection equipment.
Synthetic two-person crew transport with hot-ambient and occupant comfort requirements.
Synthetic civilian route example; route hazard status intentionally unknown and must block operational readiness.
Synthetic patient transport candidate, subject to authorized civilian route assessment; no route authorization is implied.

gate_definitions.meaning: Mission route or waterway access is authorized for this operation.
Site-specific disturbance, waste and contamination controls are approved.
A feasible platform and payload recovery plan exists.
Payload is secured within the declared loading envelope.
Required payload or occupant temperature/condition control is demonstrated.
Human occupants have appropriate restraints and emergency egress.
Accessible boarding and wheelchair securement requirements are satisfied.
Patient restraint/support and caregiver access are provided.
Personal and community-sensitive data controls are defined.
A responsible human supervisor and safe-stop behavior are present.
Route has passed the authorized humanitarian hazard assessment process.
All payloads fit together in a declared loading plan with verified restraints and center-of-mass bounds.

metric_definitions.meaning: Synthetic interval for end-to-end mission duration.
Synthetic interval for mission energy use.
Synthetic combined exposure proxy for this test fixture, not a measured damage or health risk.
Synthetic interval for restoring/retrieving the asset and payload.
